prompt:
超写实日系室内写真摄影，竖版约 3:4。一名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，站在复古奶油系卧室 / 少女感更衣室中，摄影者位于人物正前方，使用约 50–70mm 等效镜头，完整拍到头部、身体、双腿和鞋子。人物基本位于画面中央，周围保留梳妆柜、镜子、台灯和墙面环境。

人物为自然纤细偏轻沙漏型身材，肩部较窄，腰线自然，大腿和小腿匀称，不要夸张曲线。站姿轻松，身体略微向一侧倾斜，一只手藏在腰后，另一只手自然垂下；双腿靠近，脚尖略微向内，整体带一点日系复古少女写真姿态。头部轻微歪向一侧，双眼直视镜头，表情安静柔和。

留暖棕色中长波浪发，长度到胸口附近，发量柔软蓬松，发尾形成自然大卷；额前为轻薄空气刘海，两侧碎发修饰脸型。妆容清淡，棕色眼线、自然睫毛、浅粉腮红、裸粉色嘴唇，肤色白皙自然。

穿一件纯白色多层荷叶边蕾丝短裙 / 娃娃裙。整体为宽松直筒偏A字版型，从胸口到裙摆覆盖多层横向叠加的白色蕾丝荷叶边，每层边缘带细小镂空花边和柔软波浪褶。领口为浅圆领 / 小V领，肩部带宽大的白色荷叶飞袖，胸口中央系一枚细长黑色缎带蝴蝶结，形成明显黑白对比。裙长到大腿中上部，整体轻盈蓬松但不过度洛丽塔化。

双腿穿纯白色及膝长袜，袜口刚到膝盖下方，袜面分布少量规则的黑色小圆点 / 波点。脚穿黑色亮面玛丽珍平底鞋 / 低跟鞋，圆头，细横带搭扣，鞋头带小蝴蝶结和少量金属装饰，整体复古精致。

场景为柔和的奶油白＋浅粉格纹复古卧室。背景整面墙铺设浅粉、米白、淡棕组成的细密格纹壁纸，下半墙带白色护墙板和线条装饰。

画面左侧是一只象牙白复古三斗柜，带金色弧形把手和雕花柜脚；柜面靠墙放一面白色厚框矩形镜子，旁边摆着一只棕色泰迪熊、浅色干花 / 包装纸等小物件。画面右侧有一张深棕色木质边桌，上方摆放奶油白灯罩＋透明玻璃灯座的复古台灯，下层放几本浅色封面的书。

光线采用柔和窗边自然光＋轻微室内补光，整体非常明亮、低对比，白裙保留蕾丝与褶皱层次，肤色奶油白，背景呈柔和暖粉米色。不要硬闪光。

整体呈 日系杂志写真 / 复古少女房间时尚摄影质感：自然皮肤纹理、轻微柔焦、低饱和奶油色调、中等景深、画面干净柔和。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋暖棕中长卷发空气刘海＋纯白多层荷叶蕾丝娃娃短裙＋胸口黑色细蝴蝶结＋白色波点及膝袜＋黑色玛丽珍鞋＋双腿靠近内收站姿＋浅粉米色格纹墙＋象牙白复古斗柜＋镜子＋泰迪熊＋复古台灯＋奶油系室内写真。

避免：未成年人、真实学生身份、紧身包臀裙、长裙、黑丝袜、裸腿、运动鞋、厚底靴、复杂哥特洛丽塔、强闪光、暗黑背景、现代极简公寓、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic Japanese indoor portrait photography, vertical orientation approximately 3:4 aspect ratio. An unambiguously adult East Asian woman, 20+, standing in a vintage cream-toned bedroom / girlish dressing room. The photographer is positioned directly in front of the subject, using an equivalent 50–70mm lens to fully capture the head, torso, legs, and shoes. The subject is largely centered in the frame, with the surrounding vanity dresser, mirror, table lamp, and wall environment preserved.

The subject has a natural slender, slight hourglass figure, with narrower shoulders, a natural waistline, and well-proportioned thighs and calves, avoiding exaggerated curves. She stands in a relaxed pose with her body slightly tilted to one side, one hand tucked behind her waist and the other hanging down naturally; her legs are close together with toes pointing slightly inward, giving an overall subtle Japanese retro girlish portrait stance. Her head is tilted slightly to one side, eyes looking straight into the camera, with a quiet and gentle expression.

She has warm brown medium-long wavy hair reaching around the chest, soft and voluminous, ending in natural loose curls; light and airy see-through bangs across the forehead, with loose tendrils framing the face. Her makeup is light and clean, featuring brown eyeliner, natural eyelashes, pale pink blush, nude-pink lips, and fair, natural skin.

She wears a pure white multi-tiered ruffled lace mini dress / babydoll dress. The silhouette is a loose straight cut leaning toward an A-line, covered from chest to hem in multiple horizontally layered white lace ruffles, each edge detailed with delicate openwork lace and soft wavy folds. The neckline is a shallow scoop neck / small V-neck, with broad white ruffled flutter cap sleeves at the shoulders, and a slender black satin ribbon bow tied at the center of the chest, creating a distinct black-and-white contrast. The dress hem reaches the upper-to-mid thigh, overall light and airy without being excessively Lolita.

On her legs are pure white knee-high socks ending just below the knees, patterned with a sparse, regular scattering of small black polka dots. On her feet are glossy black patent Mary Jane flat shoes / low-heeled shoes with rounded toes, slim buckle straps across the instep, accented with a small bow and minimal metallic hardware on the toe, vintage and refined.

The setting is a soft cream-white and pale pink checkered vintage bedroom. The background wall is covered entirely in fine-grid wallpaper composed of light pink, off-white, and pale brown, with white wainscoting and molding along the lower half of the wall.

On the left of the frame stands an ivory-white vintage three-drawer chest featuring curved gold handles and carved feet; resting against the wall on top of the chest is a rectangular mirror with a thick white frame, beside which sit small decorative items such as a brown teddy bear, light-colored dried flowers, and wrapping paper. On the right side of the frame is a dark brown wooden side table, topped with a vintage table lamp boasting a cream-white shade and a clear glass base, with several light-jacketed books on the lower shelf.

Lighting utilizes soft natural window light combined with subtle indoor fill light, rendering the overall image very bright with low contrast, retaining the textural layers of the white dress's lace and ruffles, with creamy white skin tones and a soft warm pinkish-beige background. No harsh flash.

Overall visual aesthetic resembles Japanese magazine gravure / retro girlish room fashion photography: natural skin texture, slight soft focus, desaturated cream color palette, medium depth of field, clean and gentle composition.

Key focal points: adult East Asian woman + warm brown medium-long wavy hair with airy bangs + pure white multi-tiered ruffled lace babydoll mini dress + slender black bow at the chest + white polka-dot knee-high socks + black Mary Jane shoes + standing pose with legs close together and toes turned inward + pale pink-beige checkered wall + ivory-white vintage drawer chest + mirror + teddy bear + vintage table lamp + cream-toned indoor portrait.

Avoid: minors, actual student identity, tight bodycon skirts, long dresses, black pantyhose/tights, bare legs, sneakers, platform chunky boots, complex gothic Lolita, harsh flash, dark/gloomy backgrounds, modern minimalist apartments, anime face, CG look, plastic skin, extra limbs, watermarks, and gibberish text.

summaryTranslations.en: Retro cream-toned Japanese portrait of a young woman standing indoors wearing a white ruffled lace mini dress, polka-dot knee-high socks, and black Mary Janes.

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋暖棕中长卷发空气刘海＋纯白多层荷叶蕾丝娃娃短裙＋胸口黑色细蝴蝶结＋白色波点及膝袜＋黑色玛丽珍鞋＋双腿靠近内收站姿＋浅粉米色格纹墙＋象牙白复古斗柜＋镜子＋泰迪熊＋复古台灯＋奶油系室内写真。

避免：未成年人、真实学生身份、紧身包臀裙、长裙、黑丝袜、裸腿、运动鞋、厚底靴、复杂哥特洛丽塔、强闪光、暗黑背景、现代极简公寓、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。
translations.en: Photorealistic Japanese indoor portrait photography, vertical 3:4 ratio. A clearly adult East Asian female, 20+, standing in a vintage cream-toned bedroom/dressing room, captured full-body with a 50-70mm equivalent lens. Natural slim hourglass build, standing relaxed with one hand behind back, legs close together, soft and calm expression. Warm brown medium wavy hair with airy bangs. Wearing a pure white tiered ruffle lace babydoll mini dress featuring a thin black ribbon bow at the chest, white polka-dot knee-high socks, and black patent Mary Jane shoes. The room features pink and beige plaid wallpaper, wainscoting, an ivory dresser with a mirror and teddy bear on the left, and a bedside table with a lamp on the right. Soft, low-contrast natural window light.
